description.from:
KDATAP-08a0ac rules that human strings such as `flow:pii->checkr-api` are display forms rather than scorer identity. Correct — and the consequence needs stating before anyone estimates this programme.

Measured: 436 data-flow annotations, **424 distinct keys**, and **all 436 have bare endpoints** — `flow:user->stripe`, `flow:api-key->key_hash`, `flow:session->cookie`, `flow:password->wp_check_password`, `flow:failed-login->lockout`. The engine emits `flow:${componentKey}->${componentKey}`. Endpoints carry no `type:` prefix, and many are not components in any graph sense: a password, a session, a cookie, a lockout event. All 436 also carry a `subject.name`, and unlike mentions it is genuine prose restatement, so nothing is recoverable there.

**No existing flow annotation has a scorer identity under the new contract, and none can be migrated mechanically.** Every endpoint must be resolved to a canonical component or typed-endpoint identity by hand.

Also inert today: 419 of 436 flow annotations carry the generic label `data_flow`, which `LAYER_GENERIC_LABELS` auto-passes. Semantic classification has to come from the new data-category fields; current gold has nothing to score it against.

**Proposed decision.** Both: regold as its own tracked workstream (436 cases, human-bound, on the critical path), and publish data flows as **unscorable pending regold** in baseline series 1 rather than as a 0% strict layer. A layer reporting 0% strict on 436 unmigrated annotations is not a measurement.

Rejected: aliasing 424 prose keys, which is a hand-written answer key rather than a metric; deleting flow gold; reporting the layer as a detector failure.
description.to:
KDATAP-08a0ac rules that legacy human flow strings are display forms rather than scorer identity. The migration consequence must be explicit.

Measured: 436 annotations, 424 distinct keys, all with bare endpoints such as `flow:user->stripe`, `flow:session->cookie`, and `flow:password->wp_check_password`. Many endpoints are not components, all require typed endpoint adjudication, and 419 generic `data_flow` labels carry no semantic classification.

**Proposed decision.**

- Regold flows as a dedicated human-reviewed annotation workstream against typed canonical endpoints and data-category fields.
- At migration start, legacy accepted flow rows become `needs_adjudication` until re-reviewed; they may not remain accepted through a compatibility alias.
- Migration-readiness reports show the layer as unscorable pending regold.
- Baseline series 1 does not freeze with an unscorable headline flow layer. It waits until all accepted flow rows are canonical and the baseline-readiness threshold for count and packet diversity is approved.
- A legacy row may end accepted canonically, rejected, or still awaiting adjudication; it may not silently disappear from migration accounting.

Rejected: 424-entry alias answer key; deleting legacy flow gold; reporting legacy incompatibility as 0% detector recall; calling an unscorable migration audit the four-layer baseline.

title.from: Rule the data-flow disposition: regold, and unscorable until regolded
title.to: Rule the data-flow disposition: regold before the first baseline
